## Chimera v1.1.23

### Settings and updates
- Settings tab with an Updates card: installed, latest, channel state, Check, Install.
- Release notes render as markdown - headings, paragraphs, inline code - in a scroll panel.
- Install runs the existing updater: installer closes the app, replaces files, relaunches.

### Search and feedback
- Palette indexes every toggle, not just screens. `Fishing > Auto cast` opens Fishing, scrolls to the row and pulses it.
- Multi-word queries match in any order; row descriptions are searchable.
- Toasts were queued in the store and never drawn; one stack now sits above the status bar.

### Fisch
- Pinion's Aria: soft note chase. Rides the fish, diverts only when a note is imminent and not already covered, 700 ms hysteresis so notes stop flapping.
- Rod picker lives on Fishing; every minigame rod is selectable: Pinion's Aria, Xorcist, Record Breaker, Maelstrom, Lullaby, Noiseform, Requiem.
- `Reel source` row removed - bar, fish and shake button come from `AbsolutePosition` / `AbsoluteSize` every tick, no screenshot.
- Hotkeys moved off `RegisterHotKey` to a `WH_KEYBOARD_LL` hook that drops injected events. Fixes the macro stopping mid-reel.
- Shake timeout 30 s to 16 s (`SHAKE_TIMEOUT_MS`), tunable without a rebuild.
- Phantom rail guard requires both `reel.bar.playerbar` and `reel.bar.fish`, and a 500 ms holdover bridges a single dropped read.

### Shell
- Per-module sidebar: Overview, Fishing, Aquarium, Totems, Potions, Appraiser, Harpoon, Godfight, Visuals. Data group: Webhook, Offsets, Diagnostics, Settings.
- Overlay tab removed, ESP lives on Visuals. Harpoon standalone, Enchanting became Potions, Hyperion removed end to end.
- Window fixed at 760 x 480 with matching minimum size.
- `Hello, <username>` from the last validation, truncated so a long name cannot shove the headshot.
- Re-attach button beside the engine pill.
- Enums and hotbar slots are dropdowns; sliders use the ranges the modules were tuned for.

### Runtime
- Auto-reattach: 2 s poll, `alive()` check every 200 ms, re-validate and re-sync offsets on the next client.
- Offsets update themselves: 5 min scheduled, 60 s while validation fails, 20 s re-pull on repeated failure. No app build needed for a table change.
- Overlay reloads `offsets.ini` on mtime change, logs to `overlay.log`, dies with the core via a kill-on-close job object.
- One core per port: the shell reuses a core already listening on `127.0.0.1:47777`.
- Config fetch retries with backoff; `set()` no longer waits for the config to load.
